core_obligations: Choose an affine scheme V with an etale morphism to Y and a point z' over z (proof lines 3324-3325).
Show that the scheme theoretic image Z' of X x_Y V -> V equals Z x_Y V, so that z' lies in Z' (proof lines 3326-3328).
Use quasi-compactness of f to produce an affine scheme W with a surjective etale morphism W -> X x_Y V, and note that Z' is also the scheme theoretic image of W -> V (proof lines 3329-3333).
Apply the scheme case to W -> V, then compose with Z' -> Z and W -> X x_Y V -> X to obtain the required diagram (proof lines 3334-3350).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces with scheme theoretic image Z and a point z of |Z|, there is a valuation ring A with fraction field K and a commutative diagram Spec(K) -> X over Spec(A) -> Z -> Y whose closed point maps to z (source lines 3307-3321). The proof descends the scheme version: it picks an affine V etale over Y hitting z, notes that the scheme theoretic image Z' of X x_Y V -> V is Z x_Y V so that z lifts, uses quasi-compactness to cover X x_Y V by an affine etale W, applies the scheme case to W -> V, and composes back down to X.
